steps.assertion: The main window is visible and accessible.
Focus moves through each sidebar item with keyboard navigation.
The library view becomes active.
The imported fixture track appears in the library.
The track is selected and the details view loads.
Playback state is playing.
Playback toggles between paused and playing.
The playback position updates to the seek target.
The separation process starts for the selected track.
The stem mix levels change.
Audio output is muted.
The selected track is added to the queue.
The settings panel opens.
Appearance settings are visible.
The active model and runtime are reported.
The main window enters fullscreen.
Playback stops and the position resets.
The application process exits cleanly.

name: Installed application launch and exit smoke

steps.assertion: The installed application launches and the main window appears with a non-empty accessible name.
The installed application exits cleanly.
Window opens within the working area and all controls are reachable.
UI Automation bounding rectangles are non-zero and no control is clipped.
Minimum-size window remains operable and hit targets match visible controls.
Keyboard and pointer hit targets remain aligned with visible controls.
High contrast theme is active before the app launches.
Text and focus indicators remain visible.
Selected and disabled states remain distinguishable.
The application exits cleanly.

name: Multi-window and native dialog focus transfer

steps.assertion: One primary application window appears with a non-empty accessible name.
Main window to fullscreen player focus transfer is recorded.
Focus is restored to the main window.
Settings modal appears in the same accessibility tree with modal state.
The file picker can be cancelled without losing main window focus.
The application exits cleanly.
